text: dsh-matt-pipeline 为 DSH web 和 desktop 客户端注册随附技能，并在 dsh-better-sidebar 添加 Pipeline 面板。面板展示 Idea、Triage、Grill、Spec、Tickets、Implement、Review 阶段，可查看说明并把对应技能命令发送到当前会话；Debug、Research、Teach、Handoff、Ask Matt 也可随时启动。发送失败时会尝试复制命令到剪贴板。适合希望在 DSH 中梳理需求、拆解任务并推进实现与审查的用户。侧栏面板需要 dsh-better-sidebar，技能也能直接调用。

dsh-matt-pipeline registers bundled skills in DSH and adds a Pipeline sidebar with Idea, Triage, Spec, Tickets, Implement, and Review stages. Select a stage or Debug, Research, Teach, Handoff, or Ask Matt to send its skill command to the active session. The panel requires dsh-better-sidebar.
想在 DSH 里按阶段把一个想法整理成可执行的开发任务。
有没有侧边栏面板可以一键启动需求梳理、实现或代码审查技能？
让 DSH 帮我把讨论整理成规格说明，再拆成有依赖关系的票据。
我想从需求构思一路走到 TDD 实现和最终审查。
DSH 能不能提供随时可调用的调试、研究和交接工作流？
怎么从浏览器侧栏把一个技能命令发到当前会话？
I want a guided workflow in DSH from an idea to implementation and review.
Can I launch debugging or research skills from a sidebar in my current session?
dsh-matt-pipeline 的功能「分类需求」：选择 Triage 阶段并启动 matt-triage；阶段说明其用途是把问题归为 bug 或 enhancement。 点击对应阶段或辅助入口即可向当前 DSH 会话发送技能命令。
dsh-matt-pipeline 的功能「规格与票据」：Spec 启动 matt-to-spec 整理 PRD，Tickets 启动 matt-to-tickets 拆分票据。点击阶段即可发送命令。
dsh-matt-pipeline 的功能「实现与审查」：Implement 启动 matt-tdd，Review 启动 matt-code-review，分别用于 TDD 实现和代码审查。
dsh-matt-pipeline 的功能「辅助技能」：点击 Debug、Research、Teach、Handoff 或 Ask Matt，即可向当前会话发送对应技能命令。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Matt Pocock's skill workflow pipeline for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

The bundled skills come from Matt Pocock's [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) repository — all credit for the skill content goes to him.

dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：- **Server half**: registers the bundled matt skill set (`matt-triage`, `matt-grill-me`, `matt-to-spec`, `matt-to-tickets`, `matt-tdd`, `matt-code-review`, `matt-research`, `matt-diagnosing-bugs`, …) as model- and user-invocable DSH skills.
- **Browser half**: adds a **🔀 Pipeline** tab to the [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) showing the workflow

`💡 Idea → 🔍 Triage → 🔥 Grill → 📝 Spec → 🎫 Tickets → ⚡ Implement → ✅ Review`

dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：plus auxiliary tools (🐛 Debug / 📚 Research / 🎓 Teach / 📦 Handoff / ❓ Ask Matt). Clicking **Start** dispatches the official `/<skill>` gesture straight into the active session (clipboard fallback if the connection API is unavailable).

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Requirements：- A DSH web or desktop profile with [`dsh-better-sidebar`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) installed (the pipeline panel registers into it; the skills work without it).

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sa998aaron/deepseek-harness-matt-plugin.git
```

For the DSH Desktop GUI use the `desktop` profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/sa998aaron/deepseek-harness-matt-plugin.git
```

Then restart DSH (or toggle the plugin off/on in **Settings → Plugins**) and hard-refresh the page (Ctrl+F5).

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Manual install：1. Clone this repo into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-matt-pipeline` (e.g. `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/`).
2. In `<profile>/package.json` add the dependency and the bundle entry:
   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-matt-pipeline": "file:./node_modules/dsh-matt-pipeline" },
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-matt-pipeline" ] } }
   ```
3. Restart DSH and hard-refresh.

The built bundles (`dist/`) are committed, so no build step is needed on install.

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Usage：1. Open the sidebar's **+** menu → **🔀 Pipeline**.
2. Click a stage to see its description and expected artifact.
3. Click **Start \<Stage\>** — the panel sends `/<skill>` to the current session and the agent follows that skill's workflow.
4. Auxiliary tools at the bottom can be triggered anytime (debugging, research, handoff, …).

The bundled skills are also available directly: type `/` in the composer and look for the `matt-*` entries, or invoke them by name in chat.

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # tsdown: server ESM (dist/index.mjs) + client CJS (dist/client.cjs)
pnpm dev        # watch mode
```

Layout:

```
src/index.ts     server half: registers bundled skills (ctx.skills)
src/skills.ts    SKILL.md frontmatter parsing + registration
src/stages.ts    pipeline stages & auxiliary tools (single source of truth)
client/index.tsx browser half: registers the Pipeline tab (ctx.betterSidebar)
dsh-matt-pipeline README · Development：Note: `ctx.betterSidebar` only exists in the **browser** cordis context — UI must live in `client/`, never in the server half.

dsh-matt-pipeline README · Acknowledgements：- **[Matt Pocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)** — the skills bundled in `assets/skills/` are taken from his [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) repository. This plugin only packages them for DSH and adds the visual pipeline panel; the workflows themselves are his work. Thank you, Matt!
- **[dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)** — the sidebar host the pipeline panel registers into.

dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

Matt Pocock 技能工作流流水线插件，用于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）。

内置技能来自 Matt Pocock 的 [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 仓库——技能内容的所有功劳归属于他。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：- **服务端**：把内置的 matt 技能集（`matt-triage`、`matt-grill-me`、`matt-to-spec`、`matt-to-tickets`、`matt-tdd`、`matt-code-review`、`matt-research`、`matt-diagnosing-bugs` 等）注册为 DSH 技能，模型和用户均可调用。
- **浏览器端**：在 [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) 中新增 **🔀 Pipeline** 标签页，可视化展示工作流

`💡 Idea → 🔍 Triage → 🔥 Grill → 📝 Spec → 🎫 Tickets → ⚡ Implement → ✅ Review`
dsh-matt-pipeline README · dsh-matt-pipeline：以及辅助工具（🐛 Debug / 📚 Research / 🎓 Teach / 📦 Handoff / ❓ Ask Matt）。点击 **Start** 会把官方的 `/<技能名>` 手势直接发送到当前会话（连接 API 不可用时自动降级为复制到剪贴板）。
dsh-matt-pipeline README · 环境要求：- DSH 的 web 或 desktop profile 中已安装 [`dsh-better-sidebar`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)（流水线面板寄生于它；技能注册不依赖它）。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sa998aaron/deepseek-harness-matt-plugin.git
```

DSH Desktop 图形界面请使用 `desktop` profile：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/sa998aaron/deepseek-harness-matt-plugin.git
```

然后重启 DSH（或在 **设置 → 插件** 中将本插件关闭再启用），并硬刷新页面（Ctrl+F5）。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · 手动安装：1. 把本仓库克隆到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-matt-pipeline`（例如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/`）。
2. 在 `<profile>/package.json` 中添加依赖和 bundle 条目：
   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-matt-pipeline": "file:./node_modules/dsh-matt-pipeline" },
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-matt-pipeline" ] } }
   ```
3. 重启 DSH 并硬刷新。

仓库已提交构建产物（`dist/`），安装时无需执行构建。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · 使用：1. 打开侧边栏 **+** 菜单 → **🔀 Pipeline**。
2. 点击某个阶段，查看它的说明和预期产物。
3. 点击 **Start \<阶段名\>** —— 面板会把 `/<技能名>` 发送到当前会话，agent 随即按照该技能的工作流执行。
4. 底部的辅助工具可随时触发（调试、调研、交接等）。

内置技能也可以直接使用：在输入框输入 `/`，找到 `matt-*` 条目，或直接在对话中按名称调用。

dsh-matt-pipeline README · 开发：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # tsdown：服务端 ESM（dist/index.mjs）+ 客户端 CJS（dist/client.cjs）
pnpm dev        # watch 模式
```

目录结构：

```
src/index.ts     服务端：注册内置技能（ctx.skills）
src/skills.ts    SKILL.md frontmatter 解析与注册
src/stages.ts    流水线阶段与辅助工具（唯一数据源）
client/index.tsx 浏览器端：注册 Pipeline 标签页（ctx.betterSidebar）

注意：`ctx.betterSidebar` 只存在于**浏览器** cordis 上下文中——UI 代码必须放在 `client/`，绝不能放在服务端。

- **[dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)** —— 流水线面板所寄生的侧边栏宿主。
